title: Lab Technical Assistant
description:
THE PAPUA NEW GUINEA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY
The Papua New Guinea University of Technology (Unitech) invites applications from enthusiastic and capable individuals for the position of
Lab Technical Assistant
within the School of Applied Physics.
About the Role
This technical position offers a unique opportunity to support academic and student-led practical work in a dynamic laboratory environment. The successful candidate will assist in maintaining equipment, preparing lab setups, and ensuring safe and efficient operations during practical sessions.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in the setup, calibration, and maintenance of laboratory equipment
Support academic staff and students during practical classes and project work
Monitor inventory and ensure availability of tools and components
Uphold safety standards and assist in enforcing lab protocols
Perform basic troubleshooting and repairs under supervision
Maintain cleanliness and organization of lab spaces
Required Qualifications
Diploma in Electronics and Instrumentation
Age: Preferably under 25 years
Recent graduates from PNG Technical Colleges are highly encouraged to apply
Skills & Attributes
Basic understanding of electronic systems and instrumentation
Willingness to learn and adapt in a technical environment
Good communication and teamwork skills
Attention to detail and commitment to safety
Reliable, punctual, and proactive attitude
Salary
Lab Assistant I/II Range:
PGK17,826 – PGK24,403 per annum
(Level of appointment depends upon qualification and experience)
How to Apply.
Detailed application with updated curriculum vitae including certified copies of qualifications, names and addresses including email addresses and phone numbers of three (3) current referees — including one from a past or present employer — should be sent to:
The Executive Director – Human Resources
The Papua New Guinea University of Technology
Private Mail Bag, Lae, Morobe Province
Papua New Guinea
Applications must be compiled and sent as one PDF file to
[email protected]
, with an indication of your earliest availability to take up the appointment.
PLEASE NOTE
Deadline for all applications is

, 2025
